verdict.rationale: Synthesia's documented Video API is asynchronous: you submit a job, then poll or receive a webhook when it is ready. The completed response carries a time-limited download link for the finished .mp4, so both submission and retrieval are covered by first-party docs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the submit-and-retrieve workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can submit a video generation job through a documented API and retrieve the finished asset

citations.quote: Asynchronous — you submit a job and poll or get a webhook when it's ready.
the response includes then a time-limited download link in the `download` attribute, use this link to download the video as an `.mp4`
Video API — generate finished video files: scripted avatar videos, dubbing, translation, and templates at scale.
